hints.content: A prime number has exactly two factors: $1$ and itself.

The factors of $18$ are $1, 2, 3, 6, 9,$ and $18.$

$18$ has $6$ factors so it is **not** a prime number.

The factors of $41$ are $1$ and $41.$

$41$ has **exactly** two factors so it is a prime number.

The factors of $45$ are $1, 3, 5, 9, 15,$ and $45.$

$45$ has $6$ factors so it is **not** a prime number.

The factors of $77$ are $1, 7, 11,$ and $77.$

$77$ has $4$ factors so it is **not** a prime number.

The factors of $93$ are $1, 3, 31,$ and $93.$

$93$ has $4$ factors so it is **not** a prime number.
